description: This file defines the RecipeService class, an Android Service responsible for handling recipe-related notifications, including creating detailed notifications with recipe steps and images for a wearable device.

classes.name: RecipeService
classes.description: Android Service that manages recipe notifications and handles recipe-related actions.

classes.name: RecipeService.LocalBinder
classes.description: Binder class to provide clients with access to the RecipeService instance.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager when the service is created.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, initiates notification creation if action matches.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification for a recipe, including visual and textual details.
